name: LeadArcade
author: kafestudio

sections.description:
LeadArcade turns your WordPress site into a lead-generation machine through interactive games. Instead of a plain signup form, offer your visitors a fun experience that boosts your conversion rate.

What this plugin includes

Wheel of Fortune — an interactive prize wheel for lead capture, with every feature unlocked:

  • Fully customizable animated wheel (colors, up to 12 segments, probabilities)
  • Email capture before or after playing, with optional first name and phone
  • Prize types: text, WooCommerce promo code, URL redirect, or “no win”
  • All display triggers: shortcode, specific pages, exit-intent, timer, scroll
  • Multiple independent instances, each with its own settings and stats
  • Automatic WooCommerce coupon generation, with unique codes
  • Winner email and GDPR double opt-in
  • Statistics dashboard and CSV lead export
  • Frequency capping, device and audience targeting, scheduling
  • 100% responsive — mobile first
  • Multilingual: EN, FR, ES, DE, IT, PT (BR)
  • GDPR-compliant with customizable consent text

Also available: LeadArcade Pro

A separate plugin that adds eight more games and connects your leads to external tools:

  • Scratch Cards — touch scratch with animated reveal
  • Slot Machine — 3 reels, custom symbols
  • Mystery Box — dramatic reveal
  • Treasure Hunt — hidden eggs on the page
  • Unlock Calendar — one door per day, ideal for Advent
  • Quick Quiz — multiple choice with minimum score to win
  • Plinko — physics ball, custom landing slots
  • Memory Game — find pairs, timer, move counter
  • Email marketing sync: Brevo, Mailchimp, Mailjet
  • Webhooks: n8n, Zapier, Make

Learn more: kafestudio.fr

How does it work?

  1. Install and activate LeadArcade
  2. Go to LeadArcade → Wheel of Fortune
  3. Configure your segments and prize
  4. Copy the shortcode [leadarcade module="wheel"] into your page
  5. Your visitors play, you capture leads!

Compatible with

  • WooCommerce 7.0+
  • All WordPress themes (Full Site Editing included)
  • Page builders: Elementor, Divi, Bricks, Gutenberg

External services

This free plugin does not connect to any external third-party service. All processing (game logic, lead storage, statistics, WooCommerce coupons) happens locally on your own site, and no data is sent anywhere.

The separate Pro version optionally lets you connect, at your own choice and only after entering your own API keys, third-party email-marketing services to sync captured leads (the lead’s email, first name and phone are sent to the provider you configure, only when a lead is captured). Those integrations are not included in this free plugin. For reference:

  • Brevo — Terms of Use, Privacy Policy
  • Mailchimp — Terms of Use, Privacy Policy
  • Mailjet — Terms of Use, Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the leadarcade folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen
  3. Go to LeadArcade in the admin menu
sections.faq:
Does the plugin slow down my site?

No. Assets only load on pages where a game is present. All rendering is client-side (canvas, CSS animations).

Can visitors rig the results?

No. Probabilities and results are calculated server-side. The JS only receives the winning index and animates the wheel to that position.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes. The consent text is customizable, double opt-in is available, and you can delete a lead from the statistics.

Can I use multiple wheels on the same site?

Yes. Create as many instances as you need from the module settings — each one has its own configuration, leads and statistics, and its own shortcode.

Is WooCommerce required?

No. WooCommerce is optional. Without it, use free-text prizes or URL redirects.
sections.changelog:
1.4.0

  • All Wheel of Fortune features are now fully available: page/exit-intent/timer/scroll triggers, multiple instances, CSV export and up to 12 segments
  • Renamed all internal identifiers to the leadarcade_ prefix to avoid collisions (existing settings are migrated automatically)
  • Fixed a character-encoding issue that garbled accented characters in visitor-facing messages
  • Fixed the phone field styling in the lead capture form
  • The lead form wording now adapts to whether details are asked before or after playing
  • Updated Chart.js to 4.5.1

1.3.0

  • Added admin test mode (disables frequency limits for admins)
  • Added Phone field to lead capture
  • Customizable winner email with {first_name}, {prize}, {coupon} variables
  • WooCommerce coupon template create/select modal
  • Help page with documentation sections
  • Full multilingual support (EN, FR, ES, DE, IT, PT-BR)
  • Memory Game: auto-column grid, automatic start
  • Plinko: improved HTML5 canvas ball physics

1.2.0

  • Added Plinko module
  • Added Memory Game module
  • Mailjet integration
  • CSV lead export with Phone column
  • “Scroll” trigger for popups

1.1.0

  • Added Unlock Calendar and Quick Quiz modules
  • Multi-instances for all modules
  • Brevo and Mailchimp integrations
  • Double opt-in

1.0.0

  • Initial release — Wheel of Fortune, Scratch Cards, Slot Machine, Mystery Box, Treasure Hunt
